title: Usage-windowing credits pilot for observability, compliance pack, and premium SLA
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Validate a usage-windowing credit model that lets enterprise customers allocate discrete observability credits (retention/day, query credits) and optionally bundle a Compliance Pack + Premium SLA. Hypothesis: Offering time-bounded credits and a small, clearly-priced Compliance Pack will increase attach rate for paid observability tiers by 12% and raise average contract value for mid-market customers. Scope: pricing experiment for 3 feature bundles (Basic logs 7d, Standard logs 30d, Retention Booster 90d), Compliance Pack (audit logs + questionnaire assistance), Premium SLA (4ms p50 target + 99.95% uptime + incident support). Success metrics: attach rate, ARR uplift, churn delta at 90 days, resolution time vs baseline. Rollout plan: shadow telemetry in Week 1, soft opt-in pilot with 20 customers in Week 2, price A/B test Weeks 3-6, full rollout gated on SLO telemetry and legal sign-off. Observability: dashboards for active credit balance, retention policy usage, premium SLA fallbacks, and cost per 1M tokens. Pricing models to test: per-window credit bundle, per-seat multiplier, and flat uplift on existing reserved capacity.
Decision trade-offs: initial design prefers simple credit bundles to minimize billing complexity at the expense of per-customer granularity. If uptake is high, follow-up work will add metering per-query. Require alignment with Legal on contract language for SLA credits and with Security for Compliance Pack disclosures.
